Engine 1

Risk Assessment

Business impact analysis. Threat identification. Vulnerability scoring. Regulatory compliance. Phoenix maps your entire risk landscape — from third-party vendors to unclassified data — and quantifies your exposure before disaster strikes.

Risk Landscape — TechVault Financial

Business Impact Analysis Score 92 / 100
Identified Vulnerabilities 14 active
Exposed Assets 7 of 342 systems
Regulatory Compliance 98.4%
Insurance Coverage $50M cyber liability
Engine 2

Recovery Planning

Your RTO says four hours. Your actual recovery takes fourteen. Phoenix measures the gap between plan and reality — testing readiness, automation levels, and whether your recovery team can actually execute when the building is on fire.

Recovery Readiness — TechVault Financial

RTO Target 4 hours
RTO Actual (last test) 3 hours 42 min
RPO Target 1 hour
RPO Actual 22 min
Last DR Test 12 days ago
DR Test Success Rate 96.8%
Automated Failover 87%
Engine 3

Resilience Analysis

Redundancy without verification is hope. Phoenix validates backup integrity, measures failover speed, maps geographic distribution, and counts every single point of failure. Because one broken link can take down the entire chain.

Resilience Audit — TechVault Financial

Infrastructure Redundancy 94.2%
Failover Time (avg) 8 min 14 sec
Backup Integrity Verified All 47 systems — 24h ago
Geographic Sites 4 (US-East, US-West, EU, APAC)
Single Points of Failure 2 identified
Hot Standbys Active 12 of 12
Engine 4

Continuity Planning

When the crisis hits, who gets called? Where do people work? Which functions run first? Phoenix maps every business function, every dependency chain, every communication pathway — so when chaos arrives, you have a playbook.
